dependencies.name: Moonbase
dependencies.notes: Optional, opt-in license-activation SDK (moonbase-cpp). Header-only, MIT; fetched via FetchContent only when a developer runs `pulp add moonbase` and exports the upstream target `moonbase::licensing`. Consumed by examples/moonbase-activation/. Built with MOONBASE_USE_CURL=OFF (upstream then defines MOONBASE_DISABLE_CURL_TRANSPORT; Pulp supplies the HTTP transport over cpp-httplib/mbedTLS). Moonbase documents OpenSSL as a system requirement and v3.3.0 CMake links it unconditionally, so OpenSSL must be present at configure time; the integration uses the OpenSSL RS256 backend (OS-native crypto is optional and does not remove the OpenSSL requirement).

dependencies.name: MTS-ESP
dependencies.notes: Optional, opt-in microtuning client integration. Fetched via FetchContent only when PULP_ENABLE_MTS_ESP=ON or when a developer runs `pulp add mts-esp`. Pulp exposes it through the provider-neutral TuningProvider API; installed SDKs may ship Pulp-owned wrapper glue for pulp_enable_midi_tuning_provider(), but the ODDSound Client/libMTSClient.cpp source is fetched only on opt-in. The client dynamically loads an installed libMTS shared library at runtime when present and falls back to local 12-TET or MTS SysEx data when no master is installed. Not part of the default dependency chain.

Gated by PULP_BUNDLE_NOTO_COLOR_EMOJI CMake option (defaults ON for Linux/Android/headless/CI, OFF for macOS/Windows release builds that use the platform color-emoji typeface).

dependencies.name: Perfetto

The prebuilt trace_processor_shell query tool (same v57.2) backs `pulp trace query --trace` (offline SQL over a .pftrace); `pulp trace fetch` downloads it on demand into $PULP_HOME, SHA-256-verified, from the immutable per-platform artifacts at https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/perfetto-luci-artifacts/v57.2/<platform>/ (mac-arm64 98a41b80e9f60da0373d64aff6455681f8c26b7c391ae5736324a5b11e3dacc2, mac-amd64 c0f61397901da47cbe1bb9a0843624f7c2038ac92176ce15e3736ce9aa0afef0, linux-amd64 55ba613fc6d4f71df81eee2dbfc293020063655c241b3e314bff75345b802684, linux-arm64 1dcc1d9aaff2eb92e8bc58f1957e4e445600294bd61dbc09345c1018c5ff0868, windows-amd64 trace_processor_shell.exe 100334b6091596fbc97f872556849a5747bf47a7f7190c485ba8cea8d2409c7b). Never linked or shipped.

dependencies.name: Skia
dependencies.notes: Prebuilt via skia-builder (danielraffel fork: https://github.com/danielraffel/skia-builder) for Pulp rendering. The fork tracks olilarkin/skia-builder's tag pattern and adds iOS device/simulator, visionOS, mac-x86_64, and Skia.xcframework slices the upstream does not ship. The chrome/m152 release ships all required platform slices including linux-arm64 and restores native jsonreader/skresources archives. Visual harness determinism locks Skia plus its bundled HarfBuzz and ICU DEPS revisions; regenerate raster goldens only when any pinned Skia asset, bundled text dependency, font file, or sampler/render configuration changes.

web_toolchain.note: Skia's C++ headers and Emscripten's webgpu_cpp.h are not stable APIs. The wasm slice is only validated against this toolchain tuple; bump the tuple and the Skia pin together.

rebuild_triggers: Dawn, HarfBuzz, or ICU DEPS revision changes
skia-builder ref or release asset digest changes
Bundled font file, version, or fallback order changes
Visual harness sampler, color type, alpha type, DPI, or surface backend changes

dependencies.name: Surge Synth Team tuning-library
dependencies.notes: Optional, opt-in Scala .scl/.kbm parser and tuning-table lookup. Fetched source-only via FetchContent only when PULP_ENABLE_SCALA_TUNING=ON or when a developer runs `pulp add sst-tuning-library`; Pulp exposes it through `pulp::midi::ScalaTuningProvider` behind the provider-neutral TuningProvider API. Installed SDKs may ship Pulp-owned wrapper glue for pulp_enable_midi_tuning_provider(), but Surge's tuning-library source is fetched only on opt-in. The upstream CMake tools/tests are intentionally not added to Pulp or consumer builds. Not part of the default dependency chain.

dependencies.name: three.js

dependencies.name: TypeScript

dependencies.name: V8
dependencies.notes: Optional JS engine backend, selected with PULP_JS_ENGINE=v8 (default is QuickJS; JSC on Apple). Sealed, embeddable, shared V8 prebuilt via the danielraffel/v8-builder fork — exports only v8::/cppgc::, keeps ICU/zlib/Abseil internal so it coexists with Skia's bundled ICU without ODR clashes; Intl on. iOS is JSC-only (V8 needs JIT, forbidden in iOS apps/AUv3 extensions) — the ios-simulator asset ships headers only, no library. This milestone-matched release uses the V8 revision from Chromium M152's DEPS alongside the exact Skia chrome/m152 release pin. paired_dawn is the Dawn commit actually built into that Skia release; chromium_dawn records Chromium M152's separate Dawn DEPS pin, and dawn_matches_chromium states whether they coincide. The provider-identity/ODR gate (examples/threejs-native-demo/provider_identity_test.cmake) proves the sealed V8 and pinned Skia coexist. Re-bake CI goldens when the pin moves. Consumed by tools/scripts/fetch_v8_for_release.py + tools/cmake/FindV8.cmake (unpacks to external/v8-build/<platform>/).

dependencies.name: Vitest
dependencies.notes: Unit-test runner (with @vitest/coverage-v8) for @pulp/react and pulp-import-ir. npm devDependency, test-only; never bundled or shipped.

dependencies.name: VST3 SDK
dependencies.notes: Pin must stay at v3.8.0_build_66 or newer: that is the first Steinberg tag released under MIT. Earlier tags (including v3.7.12_build_20) offer only 'Steinberg VST3 License OR GPLv3', neither of which Pulp may redistribute inside its MIT-licensed SDK artifacts. assert_vst3_license_is_mit in setup.sh fails the setup if the pin drifts below that.
